rules.statement: Synthetic ticker policy: (1) For a multiword organization name, form the synthetic ticker from the initial letters of the meaningful name words, excluding leading articles, legal entity suffixes, and connector symbols. (2) For a single-word organization name, use a compact leading substring of that name rather than an initialism; the supplied example uses the first four letters. (3) Render synthetic tickers in uppercase.

examples.statement: Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "North Star Energy Inc." produces "NSE".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Blue River Logistics LLC" produces "BRL".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Redwood" produces "REDW".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Harbor Light Studios Ltd." produces "HLS".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "The Green Valley Bank Corporation" produces "GVB".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Cedar & Stone Foods Co." produces "CSF".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Axiom AI Technologies Inc." produces "AAT".
Applying the synthetic ticker policy to "Nova Health Group PLC" produces "NHG".

judgments.reason: The meaningful words are North, Star, and Energy; their initials form NSE, while Inc. is excluded.
The meaningful words are Blue, River, and Logistics; their initials form BRL, while LLC is excluded.
Redwood is a single-word name, so the compact leading substring illustrated by the rule is its first four letters, REDW.
The meaningful words are Harbor, Light, and Studios; their initials form HLS, while Ltd. is excluded.
The leading article The and the legal suffix Corporation are excluded; Green, Valley, and Bank yield GVB.
The connector symbol & and legal suffix Co. are excluded; Cedar, Stone, and Foods yield CSF.
The meaningful words Axiom, AI, and Technologies yield AAT, while Inc. is excluded.
The meaningful words Nova, Health, and Group yield NHG, while PLC is excluded.

overview: All examples follow the stated synthetic ticker policy.
